correctness.finding: PASS. The Pólya draw sequence is an exchangeable Beta-Bernoulli mixture, so conditional on Theta=p the loop-deleted graph is exactly the independent random-addition threshold graph T_{n,p}. Diaconis--Holmes--Janson then gives the almost-sure fixed-p threshold graph limit with the stated degree-law density. The motif polynomial follows by ordering an injective copy of H and requiring precisely the later endpoints of its edges to be dominating. The edge count E_n=sum_{t=2}^n(t-1)Z_t is exact; total variance gives the displayed formula, and the conditional weighted Bernoulli CLT applies because max j/sqrt(sum j^2)->0, yielding the stable Gaussian component.

originality.finding: FAIL. The main graphon statement is a direct conditioning corollary of two published ingredients already explicit in the sources: the 2026 model paper records the Pólya exchangeability/Beta-Binomial structure and almost-sure Beta limit of the draw average, while Diaconis--Holmes--Janson prove the exact fixed-p random-addition threshold graph limit T_{n,p}->Gamma_{mu_p}. Once the standard de Finetti Beta mixture is written down, the random graphon limit is immediate. The motif formulas and edge moments are elementary conditional counting/total-variance consequences, and the edge CLT is the standard triangular-array weighted Bernoulli CLT. The package therefore does not clear the audit's originality bar as an independent research finding.

scientific_value.finding: FAIL AS A VALIDATED NEW RESEARCH CONTRIBUTION. The calculations are correct and may be useful as exposition for the new model, but they mainly assemble standard Pólya mixing, an existing threshold-graph limit theorem, elementary motif counting, and a routine conditional CLT. No new mechanism, difficult case, sharp extremal phenomenon, or nontrivial extension of the cited graph-limit theory remains after the prior ingredients are recognized.
